senses.gloss: गुञ्जा-फल-सम-आकार गुञ्जा-फल-सम-आकार, adj. like the fruit of the guñjā, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 119.

गुञ्ज् गुञ्ज्, i. 1, Par. To buzz, Ṛt. 6, 14. गुञ्जित, n. Buzzing.
 --Cf. γογγύζω (Frequentat.).
गुञ्जा गुञ्जा, f. A small shrub, Abrus precatorius, Lin., bearing a berry which forms the smallest of the jeweller's weights, Pañc. 93, 3.
